description: Provides direct financial assistance to small and marginal farmers for purchasing farm tools and scientific equipment to enhance farm productivity.
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹5,000 transferred directly to the farmer's bank account for purchasing agricultural implements.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing in Assam owning cultivable land up to 15 bighas (approx. 2 hectares)
Tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and farm workers with active agricultural practice
documents: Land Holding Certificate / Dag-Patta Copy or Land Ownership Self-Declaration
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) / Block Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana (CMSGUY) - Tractor Distribution
description: Distributes high-power tractor units to selected farmer groups in every revenue village to accelerate double-cropping and farm mechanization.
benefits: 70% capital subsidy (up to ₹5,50,000) on tractor units with accessories, 20% covered by bank loan, and 10% contributed by the group.
eligibility: Selected farmer groups / Self-Help Groups consisting of 8 to 10 active farmers per village in Assam
documents: Land Holding Documents of Group Members
application_mode: Offline via District Agriculture Officer (DAO) / CMSGUY Society

description: Encourages millet production across rainfed regions by providing seed kits, technical support, processing infrastructure, and market linkages.
benefits: Financial incentives up to ₹12,000/hectare spread across three years, free high-yield seed kits, and micro-processing machinery grants.
eligibility: Farmers in designated project blocks of Assam taking up millet (Ragi, Foxtail, Proso) cultivation
application_mode: Offline via ADO Office / APART Project Officers

scheme_name: Assam Micro Irrigation Scheme (Per Drop More Crop - PMKSY)
description: Subsidizes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) to maximize water use efficiency for horticultural crops and tea estates.
benefits: 80% to 90% subsidy on installation costs of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for small and marginal farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning or leasing land in Assam with an assured water source (tube well, pond, river)
application_mode: Online / Offline via District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Assam State Crop Insurance Scheme (Mukhya Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
description: Protects farmers against severe crop failure caused by floods, heavy rain, dry spells, and pest attacks.
benefits: 100% premium cost subsidized by the state government for non-loanee farmers; direct bank transfer for crop loss compensation.
eligibility: All farmers (owner-cultivators and tenant farmers) in Assam growing notified crops like paddy, jute, and oilseeds
documents: Sowing Certificate from Village Headman (Gaon Burha) / ADO
Land Patta Copy or Lease Agreement
application_mode: Offline via Local Agriculture Extension Officer / CSCs

description: Offers technical guidance, subsidized fertilizers, tea garden machinery, and green leaf price monitoring to small tea growers.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy on tea plucking machines, pruning tools, transport vehicles, and free soil testing services.
eligibility: Small tea growers in Assam holding up to 10.12 hectares of land registered with the Directorate of Tea
Must hold a valid Small Tea Grower identity card
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Tea / Tea Board Development Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Free Seed Distribution Scheme
description: Distributes high-yielding and flood-tolerant crop seeds (like Sali paddy, Boro paddy, and pulses) ahead of cropping seasons.
benefits: 100% free distribution of certified high-yielding and climate-resilient seed minikits directly to registered farmers.
eligibility: Small, marginal, and flood-affected farmers residing in Assam
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) / Gram Panchayat

scheme_name: Gharua Pukhuri Janasanchay Scheme (Farm Pond Development)
description: Provides support for constructing small individual farm ponds for rainwater harvesting, fish farming, and supplementary crop irrigation.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 for excavating new ponds or re-excavating existing water storage bodies.
eligibility: Individual farmers and rural households in Assam with sufficient land for pond construction
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO) / Block Office

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Animal Husbandry & Dairy Livelihood Scheme
description: Encourages rural self-employment by assisting smallholders and SHGs in establishing small dairy farms and goat farming units.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on purchasing high-yielding crossbred cows or goats, plus subsidized cattle feed and veterinary cover.
eligibility: Individual rural youth, women SHGs, and small agricultural workers in Assam
application_mode: Offline via Veterinary Officer / Block Level Animal Husbandry Office

description: Supports traditional Muga, Eri, and Mulberry silk growers with host plant plantation grants, rearing house construction, and modern appliances.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹35,000 for constructing rearing houses, free saplings/disease-free layings (DFLs), and motorized spinning wheels.
eligibility: Traditional silkworm rearers, weavers, and farmers engaged in sericulture in Assam
documents: Sericulture Farmer Card / Land Patta Document
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Sericulture / Local Extension Officer
